drawings.description: sous les formules, à gauche : dans un repère de deux axes, un triangle rectangle dont l'angle droit est à l'origine (un côté sur l'axe vertical, l'autre sur l'axe horizontal), hachuré de traits parallèles à l'hypoténuse, coupé par une diagonale fine issue de l'origine et par une courbe sinueuse descendant du sommet supérieur vers la base ; légendes au-dessous : « $\sigma F(n)$ » et « $\mathcal{F}(n)$ ».
drawings.kind: hatched triangle in a quadrant, with a diagonal and a wavy curve
drawings.notes: The two axes through one origin, the right triangle on them (hypotenuse heavy), three hatching strokes parallel to the hypotenuse, each ending on the base (computed), the thin pencil diagonal from the origin to the upper right, and the wavy curve from the top of the triangle down to the base; the two legends below, placed where he wrote them. Still differs: the wavy curve is a free stroke, drawn smooth through points read on the crop; the number of hatching strokes (three) is a reading, a fourth short one near the origin may exist. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à droite : un quadrant d'axes $p$ (horizontal) et $q$ (vertical) couvert de droites obliques parallèles montant vers la droite ; légendes : en haut à gauche « \ill{} » et « $q$ », à droite « $p$ » et « \uncertain{filtre} » ; quelques points isolés à droite.
drawings.kind: quadrant covered with parallel oblique lines
drawings.notes: The two axes (the vertical one is doubled on the page: drawn once), eight parallel oblique strokes rising to the right, the first three starting on the vertical axis and the others on the horizontal axis, and the labels q (top of the vertical axis), p and the word read « filtre » by the transcription (uncertain there; kept) at the right; the illegible word at the upper left is left out. Four isolated dots at the right are drawn. Still differs: the strokes are free and not exactly parallel; fainter pencil strokes between them are left out, so the count (eight) is that of the ink strokes as read. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: feuillet retourné, au crayon : un repère d'axes $p$ (horizontal) et $q$ (vertical) ; le long de l'axe des $p$, à droite de l'origine, une bande étroite fermée à son extrémité ; légende au-dessus : « $F_0(-p)$ ».
drawings.kind: quadrant with a narrow band along the p-axis
drawings.notes: As on the page (sheet turned upside down; redrawn upright): the vertical axis with q at its top, the horizontal axis, which runs a little to the left of the origin and carries p at its right end, the narrow band along it from the vertical axis to its closed right end, and the legend F_0(-p) above. A very faint pencil line above the band is left out. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
drawings.orientation: sheet upside down; crop turned by 180 degrees

drawings.description: feuillet retourné, à droite du précédent, au crayon : un second repère de deux axes, traversé d'une droite oblique fine qui coupe l'axe horizontal à droite de l'origine et l'axe vertical au-dessous.
drawings.kind: pair of axes crossed by an oblique line
drawings.notes: As on the page (sheet turned upside down; redrawn upright): the two pencil axes and a thin oblique line rising to the right, which cuts the horizontal axis at the right of the origin and the vertical axis below it (it does not pass through the origin). No label. The note of the transcription calls it « une diagonale »: it is an oblique line off the origin; no consequence for the text. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
drawings.orientation: sheet upside down; crop turned by 180 degrees

drawings.description: marge droite, trois petites figures : un cercle pointé longé à droite par un long trait vertical ; plus haut à droite, un petit cercle pointé ; plus bas à droite, un petit ovale traversé d'une courbe épaisse.
drawings.kind: three small figures: pointed circles, one with a vertical line, an oval crossed by a curve
drawings.notes: As on the page: a circle with a point at its centre and a long vertical stroke which touches it at the right and runs down well below it; above at the right a smaller pointed circle (an upright oval); below at the right a small oval crossed by a heavy curve. Left out: the formulas written between the figures (given by the transcription). The note of the transcription says the circle is « traversé d'un trait vertical »: the stroke passes at its right edge. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

figures.what: pointed circle with a vertical line

drawings.description: en bas à droite, deux petites figures : trois branches issues d'un même point (deux se croisant de haut en bas, une troisième horizontale vers la droite, terminée par un point) ; à droite, un petit ovale barré d'un gros trait oblique.
drawings.kind: branches through a point; an oval with a heavy stroke
drawings.notes: As on the page: two curved branches crossing at one point, from the top to the lower left and to the lower right, and a third branch from that point to the right, ended by a point; all three drawn through the one crossing point. At the right a small upright oval with a heavy oblique stroke inside it. The upper branch is gone over twice on the page: drawn once. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: au bas de la feuille, au crayon très pâle, deux figures : deux arcs se croisant en un point marqué ; à droite, trois traits dont deux se croisent en un point marqué sous le troisième.
drawings.kind: faint pencil figures: two arcs crossing at a marked point; three lines
drawings.notes: Very faint pencil. Left: two arcs crossing at a marked point, both drawn through that point. Right: a nearly horizontal stroke and two strokes falling from it which cross at a marked point just below it. Still differs: the strokes are barely visible at 300 dpi; their ends are approximate, and the right-hand figure may have further strokes. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à gauche, sous « $F$, $H^0_x(F)$ » : deux cercles pointés, le second plus grand, et plus bas à gauche un court arc.
drawings.kind: two pointed circles and a short arc
drawings.notes: As on the page: a small upright oval with a point at its centre, a larger circle with a point at its centre to its lower right, and a short arc at the lower left. The formula that runs into the crop at the bottom is left out. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à droite, au-dessus de la formule « $g = 1 + \sum g_i + \sum n_s - \nu$ » : un petit ovale traversé d'une courbe montant vers la droite.
drawings.notes: As on the page: an upright oval crossed by a curve rising to the right. Left out: the curved and angular strokes at its right, which are braces tying terms of the formula below (not a figure), and the formula itself. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: marge gauche, en bas : un cercle épais barré d'un gros trait oblique portant un point ; plus bas, un petit carré pointé, en perspective, dans un cadre en spirale.
drawings.kind: circle with a heavy stroke through a point; a pointed square in a frame
drawings.notes: Top: a heavy upright oval crossed by a heavy oblique stroke which carries a point at the centre. Bottom: a small quadrilateral (a square seen aslant) with a point at its centre and a short stroke rising from its upper left corner, inside a frame drawn in one spiral stroke (left side, bottom, then top, right side and back under the square). Still differs: the frame is a free spiral, drawn through points read on the crop; a stroke under the square (from its left to below its right corner) is drawn as one line. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.kind: two lines crossing at a marked point
drawings.notes: As on the page: two lines crossing at a marked point, both drawn through that point. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à droite de « $k[x, y, z]/xy$ », deux figures : deux droites sécantes en un point marqué, coupées au-dessus de ce point par une troisième, plus épaisse ; à droite, deux branches courbes se coupant en un point marqué.
drawings.kind: two lines cut by a third; two curved branches meeting at a point
drawings.notes: As on the page. Left: two lines crossing at a marked point, both drawn through it, and a third, heavier, nearly horizontal line cutting both above the crossing. Right: two curved branches crossing at a marked point, both drawn through it. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
